text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Would you be interested in attending the
fireworks festival with me
tonight?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On a hot afternoon in the middle of
summer camp, Mihono Bourbon

approaches me with a slightly nervous look
on her face.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I blurt out my reply without a second
thought. It's the first time she's
ever
invited me to something. Excitement
bubbles inside of me as I
wait for the
evening to come.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
According to my research, there are an
average of 70,000 attendees
and ninety
stalls. Out of the stalls, we have nine
games to choose
from.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Shooting gallery, candy-cutting, goldfish
scooping, yo-yo balloons,
ring toss, raffle
draw, string lottery, punch box, or
watermelon
splitting. Where should we
begin?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her usual passive demeanor dissolves as
she rattles off a list of
activities. A look of
determination sparkles in her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I neither like nor dislike them. I would say I
have an average amount
of appreciation
for them.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...I believe that spending time together will
deepen our connection.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Well... up until now, I have been
categorizing social events like this as

inconsequential.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: But perhaps... I was mistaken.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As she speaks, a hint of emotion colors her
voice. Her hand brushes
against her
pocket, revealing a familiar-looking
stuffed animal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The small round eyes of the bunny peek
out from underneath the
fabric.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
For a long time, I struggled to understand
the significance of "having
fun."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
But for some reason, when this toy is with
me, training and studying
become
radically different. My motivation levels
are amplified.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I began engaging in social
interactions, I've realized that
there is
value in pursuing "enjoyment."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps this is what my parents wanted me
to understand.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Not sociability as a parameter, but as...
something warmer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon's words come together
like puzzle pieces, spelling
out her growth
and awareness. I feel prouder than ever,
knowing how
much effort it must've taken
to arrive at this conclusion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I lead the bemused student onto the
crowded main street, eager to
make the
best of the evening.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Please aim five degrees lower. You're too
low now, go up—that's
right, stop right
there.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Click, pop!

text_block_list.name: Shooting Gallery Staff
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, you're a good shot, mister!
Congrats on winning the grand
prize!

text_block_list.name: Shooting Gallery Staff
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, you're a good shot, miss! Congrats
on winning the grand prize!

text_block_list.name: Shooting Gallery Staff
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, that's what I call teamwork! Here
ya go, now don't lose it on
the way back
home!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We visit nearly every game stall, basking
in the festivities. Time flies
and before we
know it, the night draws to a close.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The fireworks will begin shortly. I suggest
we move to a better
location for optimal
viewing.

text_block_list.name: Honest Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Huh? Is that... Bourbon?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Waving at us from the distance is the girl
who approached Bourbon
the other day.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
You engaged me in conversation during
my break. Statistically, this
action suggests
a underlying motive.

text_block_list.name: Honest Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I just wanted to talk to you... I'm sorry for
taking up your time! I'll get
going now!

text_block_list.name: Honest Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Wow, I didn't expect to bump into you
here! What a coincidence!
O-oh but, I'm
sorry if I'm interrupting you two...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
No need to worry. ...Did you also come
here to observe the fireworks?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Tonight's display will showcase an
impressively large circular design
as the
centerpiece. It is something that I am, as
you would say,
"looking forward to."

text_block_list.name: Honest Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Umm... That's it? You're just looking
forward to the fireworks? Like,
no
scientific reason or anything?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Correct.

text_block_list.name: Honest Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume looks at Mihono
Bourbon, puzzled by her simple
response.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the past, the stoic student would've
launched into an analytical
monologue.
Now, she's taking in the sights and living in
the moment.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Understood.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Carefully, Mihono Bourbon turns to the
student.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Would you like... to view the fireworks
together?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Peeew! Boom!

text_block_list.name: Honest Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Wow, they're so pretty! I wasn't sure about
coming to the festival by
myself, but I'm
really glad I plucked up the courage!

text_block_list.name: Honest Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Bumping into you, looking at pretty things
together—ah, sorry! I hope
I'm not boring
you with this conversation...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
No, please continue. Do you find these
explosions enjoyable?

text_block_list.name: Honest Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I love them! It doesn't matter
whether they're big or small, just
being
around them makes me feel like I can do
anything! I love
experiencing things that I
normally can't, like fireworks or even being

text_block_list.name: Honest Umamusume
text_block_list.text: with people!

text_block_list.name: Honest Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Which is why I got a little ahead of
myself. I'm sorry if I made you

uncomfortable earlier when I called out to
you. Sometimes I'm not
good at keeping
my distance...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I understand. If calculating distances is not
your forte, then I may be
of great
assistance.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
For example, there are thirty-four
centimeters of space between us.
The
shaved ice stall behind you at four o'clock
is eight meters and
twenty-four
centimeters away.

text_block_list.name: Honest Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Are you... naturally like this?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
If you are referring to my physical
composition, then yes, I am all
natural. I
do not possess any mechanical
components.

text_block_list.name: Honest Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I think I figured you out now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Underneath the spectacular illuminations,
the two students chatter
away as if the
fireworks will never stop.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next day.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Father, it's Mihono Bourbon. I am
calling to inform you that
your order has
been exec—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Actually, my apologies. I would like to
report a change in personal
affairs instead.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I... made a friend.
